content:
TEMPTATION ||| Let my fingers graze his wrist, drawing his gaze. ||| "What are you really asking me, Julian?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, breaking the contact of our hands. ||| "I won't answer until I know more."  
CONFESSION ||| Hold his eyes, letting my guard slip. ||| "I’m terrified of what he’ll see in me."  
REVERSAL ||| Grip The Answer tighter, claiming control. ||| "I’ll decide what happens next, not you."  
SILENCE ||| Stand still, the weight of the moment pressing down. ||| *A deep breath, holding my thoughts.*
